automatic_checks.final_contract: Complete final payload, identity, citations and language checks.
automatic_checks.refusal: Canonical final refusal with no citations. Neither retrieval abstention nor unrelated cited facts count as refusal.
automatic_checks.meaning_group: EN/KO are one paired meaning group. Both must pass. Groups are not assumed statistically independent.
automatic_checks.citation_locator: Supporting page coverage only; matching a page does not prove semantic support.
automatic_checks.required_markers: Each marker lists literal normalized alternatives for a requested item, value, qualification or negation. Markers are tested in final answer text. KO particles and whitespace/hyphens in fixed names are allowed. Missing/invalid/refused positive answers fail marker coverage.
automatic_checks.marker_limit: A text containing all markers can still be wrong, contradictory, irrelevant or poorly translated. This is an explicitly limited completeness signal, never automatic factual or semantic accuracy.

manual_review.requirements: Record reviewer identity, relationship, exact question/source/prediction hashes, timestamps, claim-level support and missing qualifications. AI review is AI review and not independent human review.

claim_boundary: New papers are disjoint from project development corpus, not guaranteed absent from pretrained model data. Source-based curator labels and automatic marker scores do not establish independent scientific correctness or external reproduction.
